verses.text: Ha winhaj Jotam chi', 25 ab'il sk'inal winh ayik ix och winh reyal. 16 ab'il ix yak' reyal winh t'a Jerusalén. Jerusa sb'i ix snun winh, yisil ix winhaj Sadoc.

Ha tas ix sk'ulej winhaj Jotam chi', wach' t'a yichanh Jehová icha ix sk'ulej winhaj Uzías smam winh. Palta maj ochlaj winh t'a yol stemplo Jehová icha ix yutej sb'a winh smam winh chi'. Haxo masanil anima, te chuk tas ix sb'eyb'alej heb'.
Ha winhaj Jotam chi' ix chekan b'ojok jun spuertail templo t'a yib'anh. Tzijtum tas ix schek winh b'ojok t'a yib'anh smuroal chonhab' b'aj mukb'il jun ch'olan.
Ix schekan winh b'ochajxik'e juntzanh niwak chonhab' t'a tzalkixtak t'a yol yik Judá yet' yet'tal heb' winh soldado chaanh yajk'e b'aj stanhwej heb' winh t'a kaltak te'.

Ix yak' owal winh yet' heb' amonita, ix ak'ji ganar heb' yuj winh. Ha t'a jun ab'il chi', ix yak' k'een tumin heb' ix ak'jioch t'a yib'anh yak'an t'a winh. Ix yak' 75 kintal k'een plata heb' yet' 37 mil kintal ixim trigo. Hanheja' icha pax chi' ixim kebada ix yak' heb'. Icha chi' ix sk'ulej heb' t'a oxe' ab'il.
Te tek'an ix aj winh t'a sreyal chi', yujto te wach' sb'eyb'al winh t'a yichanh Jehová.
Ha jantakto yab'ixal winhaj rey Jotam chi' yet' tastak sk'ulejnak winh yet' jantak owal yak'nak winh, aykan b'aj tz'ib'ab'ilkan yab'ixal heb' winh sreyal Israel yet' Judá.
Ayik ix och winh t'a reyal, 25 ab'il sk'inal winh. 16 ab'il ix yak' reyal winh t'a Jerusalén.
Haxo yik ix cham winh, ix mukji winh yet' heb' smam yicham t'a schonhab' winhaj David. Ixlajwi chi', haxo winhaj Acaz yuninal winh ix ochkan reyal sk'exulok.
